annotations.title: Read a project with GeoThought's model

description: Have GeoThought's reader read a project of the person's: every document is asked its schemas' questions and the answers are kept with their page and box. `model`: a model id from geothought_models (default: the person's choice, else GeoThought's own). Optional `schemas` (names), `documents` [{corpus, key}], `limit`, `force` (read again what was read). Follow it with geothought_reading_status.
name: geothought_start_reading
title: Read a project with GeoThought's model
